question: Can Pieter De Smet work remotely from Lyon (France) from 1 October 2026 to 31 January 2027?
expected_answer: Not as requested. The HRBP's Teams message is not a valid approval: policy v2 requires the HR Director's written approval. ≈83 working days exceed the 60-day annual cap (derogation only by the HR Director with an amended telework annex; CCT 85 and his annex fix Uccle as place of telework). Working 100% in France means French social security applies (art. 11(3)(a) Reg. 883/2004) unless an A1 posting certificate (art. 12) is obtained before departure; the company CCT forbids starting without this check. Tax likely stays Belgian (<183 days, Belgian employer, no French PE) but must be checked. Workable answer: up to 60 working days in 2026 with A1, the rest only via formal derogation. The archived v1 ban no longer applies.
key_facts: Request 01/10/2026–31/01/2027, ≈83 working days, A1 not requested (REC-Q03-01)
Tom: 'Sure, go ahead' (CHAT-Q03-01); Legal: do not confirm (EML-Q03-02, INV-Q03-01)
Pieter already signed a lease relying on Tom's message (STM-Q03-01)

conflicts.why: An informal chat by a non-competent person cannot override the approval procedure (though it may create an expectation to handle fairly).

conflicts.issue: Is working abroad allowed at all?

conflicts.why: EU regulation is directly applicable mandatory law.
